english.notes:
(i) Section 2(1) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1994 adds 'imitation firearm' to section 20 of the Firearms Act 1968.
(ii) See also associated offence wordings H483, H497 and H498.
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).
(vi) See also Home Office Guidance on Firearms Licensing Law.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

Time limit for prosecutions:
48 months
